description: This policy audits the configuration of Local Administrator Password Solution (LAPS). For more information, see https://aka.ms/LAPS4ARC.

configurationParameter.AutomaticAccountManagementNameOrPrefix: Enforce automatic account name or prefix;Value

metadata.description: By selecting this option, you agree to be charged monthly per Arc connected machine.
Set the effect for this policy. AuditIfNotExists will audit machines. Disabled will disable the policy.
Configure which directory the local admin account password is backed up to. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Azure Active Directory, 2 = Active Directory.

Configure the complexity of the generated password. 1 = Large letters, 2 = Large letters and small letters, 3 = Large letters, small letters, and numbers, 4 = Large letters, small letters, numbers, and special characters.
Configure the length of the generated password. Minimum is 8, maximum is 64.
Configure the number of words in the generated passphrase. Minimum is 3, maximum is 10.
Configure the maximum password age in days. The password will be rotated after this number of days.
Configure the actions to take after authenticating with the managed account. 0 = None, 1 = Reset password, 3 = Reset password and logoff, 5 = Reset password and reboot.
Configure the delay in hours before the post-authentication actions are executed.
Configure the name of the local administrator account to manage. Leave empty to manage the built-in administrator account.
Configure whether the password is encrypted before being stored in Active Directory. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.
Configure the user or group that is authorized to decrypt the password from Active Directory.
Configure how many previous encrypted passwords are stored in Active Directory. 0 = Disabled.
Configure whether password expiration protection is enabled. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.
Configure whether automatic account management is enabled. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.
Configure the target for automatic account management. 0 = Built-in administrator account, 1 = New local admin account.
Configure the name or prefix for the automatically managed account.
Configure whether the name of the managed account uses a random numeric suffix. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.
Configure whether to enable the automatically managed account. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.
